manifest.description: Probe-or-refuse rename surface via rename_elixir_symbol. v1 always refuses with the capability matrix because elixir-ls and lexical have no working textDocument/rename provider as of 2026-05. Exists so callers don't reinvent syntactic rename (which would unsafely miss name: __MODULE__ registrations, supervisor child specs, @behaviour references).
when_to_use: operator wants to know what would be renamed before doing it manually
diagnostic: verify the position/symbol_kind would be matched by a future LSP rename
anti_patterns: do not expect any v1 rename to apply — every symbol kind refuses
do not use as a wrapper around manual rename — operator does that in their editor

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-rename-symbol. v1 ALWAYS refuses; surface the capability matrix.

Protocol:
1. bbox_refactor_plan(kind="rename_elixir_symbol", source="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}", toml_entries={"position_line": {{position_line}}, "position_column": {{position_column}}, "new_name": "{{new_name}}", "expected_symbol_kind": "{{expected_symbol_kind}}"}).
2. Expect error.symbol_not_renameable with the capability_matrix payload.
3. Emit bbox_note(kind="blocked", body=<refusal summary + operator hint to perform the rename in their editor>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{position_line}} {{position_column}} {{new_name}} {{expected_symbol_kind}}
